name: Muldjord (DrumGizmo)
description: Big metal-style kit with double kick, four toms and a china. 16 mics mixed to stereo.

name: ShittyKit (DrumGizmo)
description: Cheap, characterful Stagg kit in a raw room. Close mics, overheads and M/S room.

name: SM Drums
description: Deeply sampled collector kit (up to 64 velocity layers in the source). Stereo mix, four toms, two rides.

name: Roland TR-808
description: The 808: boomy kick, snappy snare, cowbell, toms. Michael Fischer's recordings.

name: TR-909 Detroit
description: 909 recorded through API and Neve: punchy house and techno.

name: Hard Trap
description: Distorted 808s, heavy kicks, crisp snares. 808 bass on the low tom pads.

name: Bounce
description: Round 808s, tight kicks, snappy claps: West Coast bounce.
